text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Hanshin J.F. has finally arrived. This huge stage will be Mejiro Dober's first G1 race, but…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: …All right.
choice_data_list: You don't seem nervous at all.
You don't seem nervous at all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Are you saying I should be? Well, I am a little surprised at how calm I am.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I'm a little surprised by how calm I feel.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I want to do well today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I want to do well today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Well enough to believe that I actually stand a chance in the Tiara tour!
choice_data_list: You have your promise with Bright to keep.
You have your promise with Bright to keep.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Eyes aglow with determination, she seems to be shaking more out of excitement than anxiety.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm sure she's going to do great out there!
choice_data_list: Get out there and bring home the win!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I don't need you telling me to do that. Anyway, I'm off.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I will. See you soon!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Prepare to be dazzled, everyone! I'll show you shining brilliance like you've never seen before!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Prepare to be dazzled, everyone! I'll show you shining brilliance like you've never seen before!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Wow… It's hard to believe this is Pearl's first big race too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (I guess that's no surprise coming from someone who's always boasting that the world is her oyster.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (I can't lose out to her in spirit, though! I'm going to put myself out there and be just as bold!)

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I like the look in your eyes, Dober. Filled with determination and competitive spirit.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Pearl…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: What a splendid day to pit our budding potentials against each other. It's nearly showtime!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'm going to give this race everything I've got, and I won't lose!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: They're about to step up to the gate for the Hanshin J.F.! Who will emerge as the junior Goddess?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Those cheers… So this is what a G1 feels like.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (I can't stop shaking… The track feels even bigger than usual.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (The soles of my feet feel strangely hot too, like they're absorbing heat from the turf.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Phew…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'll be okay. It'll all be okay.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'm calm. I can do this. I…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I can run!
